overview_description.description:
Logica is now part of CGI, a global IT and business process services provider delivering business consulting, systems integration and outsourcing services. With 69,000 professionals in 40 countries, we have the presence, expertise and complete IT services to meet clients’ business needs anywhere, anytime and to offer our professionals challenging and rewarding careers.

 Learn more at www.cgi.com.
